LanguageData.IFR_AnimalsTip: Player-faction animals can rank and gain XP even when the original Exclude Animals setting is enabled. Wild animals still follow the original setting.
LanguageData.IFR_HostilesTip: Disables rank stats, XP, aura and rank rewards for pawns in factions hostile to the player, including humanlikes, animals and mechs. Player-owned animals remain eligible.
LanguageData.IFR_PlayerOnlyTip: Also excludes neutral, allied and factionless pawns, including wild animals. Overrides the hostile-faction toggle. Prisoners belonging to another faction are excluded.
LanguageData.IFR_Notes: Uses current faction and diplomacy. Taming or recruitment restores eligibility. Saved levels and XP are retained; existing Isekai traits are suppressed while their owner is excluded.
LanguageData.IFR_RetentionTip: Overrides original retention while Allow player-owned animals is enabled. 0% means no stat bonuses; 100% means full bonuses. Like the original setting, this applies to player-owned non-mech creatures and their stat explanations.
